title: Hold and Referral Time Limits by Testing Supplies Tier
content:
Status limits of the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program:

| Tier | Shipments held during an inpatient stay | Longest hold, calendar days from the hold start date | Referral documentation window, calendar days from the enrolled date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | No | 180 | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | Yes | 60 | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | Yes | 60 | 30 |

- *Shipments held during an inpatient stay* — whether shipments must be held while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility, because the payer does not pay home supplies during a covered stay.
- *Longest hold* — the longest time a program may remain on hold, in calendar days counted from the hold start date, before it is closed administratively.
- *Referral documentation window* — the time allowed to complete the referral documentation (the written order on file and, where required, the prior authorization decided), in calendar days counted from the program's enrolled date.
